name: Boboniu and Bit Operations
description: Boboniu likes bit operations. He wants to play a game with you. Boboniu gives you two sequences of non-negative integers $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n$$$ and $$$b_1,b_2,\ldots,b_m$$$. For each $$$i$$$ ($$$1\le i\le n$$$), you're asked to choose a $$$j$$$ ($$$1\le j\le m$$$) and let $$$c_i=a_i\& b_j$$$, where $$$\&$$$ denotes the bitwise AND operation . Note that you can pick the same $$$j$$$ for different $$$i$$$'s. Find the minimum possible $$$c_1 | c_2 | \ldots | c_n$$$, where $$$|$$$ denotes the bitwise OR operation .
input_specification: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ ($$$1\le n,m\le 200$$$). The next line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$a_1,a_2,\ldots,a_n$$$ ($$$0\le a_i \lt 2^9$$$). The next line contains $$$m$$$ integers $$$b_1,b_2,\ldots,b_m$$$ ($$$0\le b_i \lt 2^9$$$).
output_specification: Print one integer: the minimum possible $$$c_1 | c_2 | \ldots | c_n$$$.
approach_summary: Define state dp[mask][i] capturing the subset of visited/chosen elements. Transition by iterating over valid unset bits in O(2^N × N) time.
